forum.title: Map demo of TouchGFX on NeoChrom/NeoChromVG
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

This demo is different from most other demos we share, since the map rendering is using direct NeoChromVG commands instead of the usual TouchGFX rendering. This makes it more complex to distribute and use and it is therefore not shared through our usual channels. Instead, you can contact my colleague Jorgen Mygind directly on jorgen.mygind@st.com for more info and to request the demo project.

Best regards,

Peter
